items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: And then I went with Punch, you see? After Punch quit Jack Carey, where he was taking Jack's whole band. He played with him. Ask him if you played with Jack. ... Oh yeah. Yeah, I remember his band when you remember.

ctx.x: First was Wesley Dunn. Yeah, and second was Blue. Yeah. And third was who? What's the man this? No, ask him who the third corner.

Who was the third corner player? William Padjo. William and Ricard Ellis was the fourth. Oh, huh. And then Willie Edwards was the fifth. George McCullen was the sixth. Albert Du Conger, he was the seventh. Chris Kelly, he was another good corner player. You hear what I'm talking about? And then I played by the fellow with the third. And then Johnny Henry with the third. And then I went with Punch, you see? After Punch quit Jack Carey, where he was taking Jack's whole band. He played with him. Ask him if you…
Did you play with Jack any?

items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-11
items.q: He used to play with me, different bands.

ctx.x: Ask him did he play with Jesse Jackson.

So did he play with Jesse Jackson? Yeah, he used to play with him. Right. He used to play with different bands too. He used to play with me, different bands. He'd go to Dave Parsons and grab the drum with a cab back. I had to go up there and get it. Uh, he used to call his son. But nobody know first names, last names, so they called his names. It's not. Every single kid Prince, I know they're that person. Kid Prince, Kid Prince. Kid Prince and Jack Cavie. Then they had their names. All up the line, and people…
Who? Ask him who was with Jack Terry.
